libwebp 1.5.0 (https://github.com/webmproject/libwebp, tag v1.5.0; the same as
https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/releases/webp/libwebp-1.5.0.tar.gz).
Only src/{dec,dsp,enc,utils,webp} and sharpyuv are kept: the texture pack (0.42) encodes and decodes WebP.
